A Roof First. A House Next.
14 April 1992  |  Kathmandu
You are not fated to die without a home.
Simple plan  |  5 September 2026

The one thing that is not true
Your chart does not say you die without a home. It says home is delayed, then solid -- and that you can lose time by
hiding, waiting for a perfect house, or signing a foggy deal. Fear of dying homeless is real. Treat it as fuel for this
week's roof, not as a prophecy.
TWO DIFFERENT GOALS -- DO NOT MIX THEM
Goal A, this month: a lockable legal door. Shared room, family if safe, hostel, staff housing, ashram bed, anything that
is not the street. Goal B, 2027-28: land, title, or the start of a house in your name. If you wait for Goal B before you
take Goal A, you stay unhoused. The harvest window is for owning. Survival housing is now.
What the chart actually says about a house
The planet that rules home sits strong in the money house. That is a real promise of property through earnings, not a
lottery. A slow planet delays it and demands accounts, sleep, and no leaks. This 7-year chapter (2022-2029) is when
you fight for land and a name. Classical texts even list houses and land as a theme of this chapter when you act. The
best time to put a deposit, title, or build in motion is 20 July 2027 to September 2028. That does not mean you stay
outside until then.
This week -- roof and papers
1) A door that locks. If family is safe, using that roof for a while is not failure. Pride is expensive when you have no
walls. If family is unsafe, do not go back. In Kathmandu, the city and Manav Sewa Ashram run holding and shelter
routes for people with no support -- use them if you have nowhere else. 2) Identity papers, a working phone, a SIM in
your name, a bank or wallet that can receive pay. Jobs need an address. Use a friend's, a workplace, or a shelter. 3)
Money that arrives this week: any legal paid work. Not a brand. Not a perfect company. Pay, then repeat. 4) Sleep and
food. Exhaustion makes this chart cancel good chances.
How the money arrives (not a fantasy)
You are paid for named skill: work people can hire -- technical, fixing, training, investigation, billed advice, teaching,
hands, starting things. You are not paid for being the unpaid genius in someone else's shop. Ask for wages in writing.
Until February 2027, expect a first no, then a yes after one correction -- a job, a room, a document. File it. 6 November
to 24 December 2026 is the best stretch this year to put a job or a room on paper. 13 September to 6 November 2026:
people may offer 'quick money' or foreign schemes. Research. Do not sign. Desperation is how scams hunt.

Own-house timing is 2027-28. Tonight's roof has no astrological waiting period.
Things you may not be watching
Pride. Refusing a shared room, staff housing, or a family roof because it is not 'your house yet' can keep you outside.
A lockable door is a win. The almost-done habit. Almost applying, almost asking, almost filing. Housing is lost in
the last 10%. Spending leaks. Drink, endless 'one more plan', lucky stones, courses you do not finish. This chart leaks

in private. Close the leak. Scams. Anyone who wants your last money, your passport, or 'invest now, house later' in
the next two months. Health. Street or unstable sleep wrecks this engine. One checkup. Teeth, feet, infection, head.
You cannot earn a house from a hospital bed you ignored. Using a partner as housing. Do not marry or move in this
winter only to have a roof. That uses a person as medicine and this chart punishes it. Waiting for 2027 to exist.
2027-28 buys or builds. 2026 keeps you alive and employable.
90-day order of operations
Week 1: door, papers, phone, any pay. Weeks 2-8: repeat the pay; keep the door; do not sign foggy deals. 6 Nov-24
Dec: lock a job or a longer room in writing; draft a public price for your skill. Then: save every extra into a house jar
you do not touch except for a legal deposit. By July 2027 you want: a roof, repeating income, a pile toward land, and a
name people can hire. Then the harvest window can become a title.
THE SENTENCE THAT KEEPS PEOPLE UNHOUSED IN THIS CHART
'I'll do it properly later.' Later is how a strong house yoga stays on paper. Tonight: ask for the room, the shift, the wage,
the help. One action. Do not reverse it.
If family is safe, a temporary roof there is strategy, not shame. If you are in danger, get to people and a public place; in
Kathmandu, city rescue and Manav Sewa Ashram are active shelter routes. If hopelessness turns into not wanting to
be alive, that is a medical emergency -- tell someone and get local crisis help. Wanting a house and not wanting to die
on the street is a will to live. Use it this week.
Birth 14 April 1992, 3:57 AM, Kathmandu. Not medical, legal, or financial advice.
